headline: Approved bids for snow removal and salting and for rubbish and recycling, and monitored a report on treatment of community.
summary: The meeting covered the Strategic Plan process, the Act 170 merger committee, and a student presentation on the International Experience exchange program. The Board approved bids for snow removal and salting and for rubbish and recycling. It also agreed to monitor Monitor Report 2.3 on the Treatment of Community policy.
decisions: Approved monitoring of Monitor Report 2.3 Treatment of Community using the monitoring rubric, all in favor.
Approved the bid for snow removal and salting, all in favor.
Approved the bid for rubbish and recycling, all in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: Seamus Abshere called for a motion to monitor Monitor Report 2.3 Treatment of Community using the monitoring rubric included in the Board materials. Tom Chittenden moved, Emilee Hoffman seconded. No discussion. All in favor; motion passed.
Seamus Abshere called for a motion to approve the bid for snow removal and salting... All in favor; motion passed.
Seamus Abshere called for a motion to approve the bid for rubbish and recycling. Emilee Hoffman moved and Tom Chittenden seconded the motion. No discussion. All in favor; motion passed.
